title: The Name of the Stone Tablet
next_chapter_hook: Just as the four were immersed in shock, a wisp of black energy suddenly seeped from the cracks at the base of the stone tablet. That aura was icy cold and bone-piercing, carrying an ancient and dangerous fluctuation—as if something was awakening.

text.content: In the withered hand of the ancestor, the yellowed fragment emitted a faint ethereal glow, as if bearing the weight of a thousand jun. Chen Ji unconsciously reached out to receive it, and the moment his fingertips touched the paper, a torrent of searing information poured into his mind—the fourth page, the fourth page of the Tianji Record, actually recorded a set of coordinates. "Mo Xiansheng, have you ever known of this place?" He forcibly suppressed his surging thoughts, yet his voice betrayed a hint of urgency. The remnant soul guardian fell silent for a moment, his phantom form trembling violently: "This... this is the forbidden ground of the Tianji Record, this old one truly does not know. Just how many secrets did my master conceal?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stepped forward, her delicate hand raised gently, and a strand of spiritual energy lifted the fragment steadily. Her gaze narrowed as she carefully examined the ancient runes upon it. After a moment, she exclaimed softly: "These runes... are identical to the transmission mark of the founding ancestor of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji, was your ancestor truly just an ordinary elder?" Her tone carried three parts curiosity, three parts wariness, yet also four parts of indescribably complex emotions.

Ye Qing's demonic aura rippled gently around her as she approached slowly, her twilight-purple eyes flickering with an unusual glint: "Interesting, this aura... is extremely similar to the ancient remnant soul fluctuation I sensed in the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. It seems this Chen Xuan predecessor was no small figure indeed." The corner of her lips curved slightly, her words hiding a probing intent: "Chen Ji, you should be careful. Some truths, once known, become a curse instead."

text.content: The coordinates on the fragment pointed to an unexplored region deep within the ruins. The four followed the traces, passing through layers of collapsed stone corridors, finally arriving at a sealed underground stone chamber. In the center of the chamber stood a towering three-zhang black stone tablet, its surface covered in dense golden characters. Despite countless ages, those inscriptions still gleamed brilliantly, as if awaiting the arrival of one with destiny.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji walked slowly toward the stone tablet, his gaze sweeping across the inscriptions. At first, they were merely ordinary family migration records. However, the further he read, the more violently his heart pounded. "Chen Xuan, seventh-generation disciple of the Tianqing Sect, the continent's first prophet, who glimpsed a sliver of life beyond the天道 cycle and created the method of defying fate..." He murmured aloud, his voice gradually trembling. "So... my Chen family's ancestor was the first person to break the cycle of fate."

text.content: The inscriptions on the stone tablet were far more extensive than this. The records detailed how Chen Xuan discovered the Tianji Record fragments, how he step by step gathered each fragment, how he survived with grueling difficulty amid the encirclement and suppression of the three great sects and the Demonic Path—he had once alone infiltrated the Xuanwu Sect's forbidden grounds to steal the second page, and had also allied with the then Demonic Path's Holy Maiden to withstand the heavenly tribulation together. What was even more shocking was the inscription's end: "The Tianji Record contains seven pages; when united, they can reshape the laws of heaven. However, with each page united, the cost must be paid in heavenly fate..."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao drew a sharp breath, her beautiful eyes widening: "Reshape the laws of heaven... Chen Xuan predecessor's ambition was truly so grand? No wonder all successive sects wanted to exterminate every Tianji Record holder." She turned to Chen Ji, her gaze complex: "You obtaining the Tianji Record fragment was no coincidence, but a bloodline inheritance... Chen Ji, your identity is probably far more complicated than we knew."

Ye Qing suddenly laughed softly, that laughter echoing peculiarly in the silent stone chamber: "Interesting, truly interesting. This Holy Maiden once read fragmentary passages in the Holy Sect's classics, about an ancient prophet who defied heaven and changed fate, ultimately erased by the Eye of Heavenly Law. Now looking at this, that predecessor was not only not erased, but left behind for future generations the key to unraveling fate's shackles." She gazed at Chen Ji, her eyes flashing brilliantly: "Chen Ji, that useless persona of yours probably won't be sustainable much longer."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent, his gaze firmly fixed on the very bottom of the stone tablet, where a line of text almost blurred by the ages was carved. He bent down to examine it closely, his fingertips gently brushing away the dust, and a complete sentence gradually revealed itself: "The seventh page lies within the core of the Eye of Heavenly Law." His pupils constricted sharply—the Eye of Heavenly Law, that was the legendary incarnation of heavenly will that stood above all powers!

The air within the stone chamber seemed to solidify, all four falling into wordless silence. Ye Qing's breathing grew rapid, Su Qingyao's jade-like hand unconsciously gripping her sword hilt tight. Even the usually carefree Chen Ji wore an expression of rare gravity. After a long while, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul phantom drifted slowly out from the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's embrace. He gazed at the stone tablet, his voice hoarse: "So he... truly never gave up that step. Seven pages of heavenly secrets, seven layers of defying fate—this was to perish together with heaven..."

choice.prompt: The information on the stone tablet was immense; Chen Xuan ancestor's footsteps seemed to have traversed the world. Chen Ji faced a choice—to continue pursuing along the route his ancestor once took, or to find another way?

choices.description: Follow the route recorded on the stone tablet, visiting each place Chen Xuan once stepped upon, perhaps finding clues to other fragments.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time and energy, may encounter Chen Xuan's former old enemies
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Tianji Record puzzle route
choices.risk_hint: Strong enemies will surely lurk along the way, requiring thorough preparations

text.content: Su Qingyao was the first to speak: "Since Chen Xuan predecessor could walk this path, we are not necessarily incapable." Her gaze was firm, as if already prepared for a long journey. Ye Qing's lips curved into a playful smile: "Interesting, this Holy Maiden actually wishes to see what treasures this ancient sage left behind."

choices.description: The stone tablet hints that the Eye of Heavenly Law is where the seventh page lies; instead of roundabout searching, directly head to the core area of the Eye of Heavenly Law.
choices.visible_cost: The Eye of Heavenly Law's location is surely a dragon's pool and tiger's den, nine deaths and one life
choices.visible_reward: Fastest to obtain the complete Tianji Record, directly challenge the ultimate goal
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient strength yet rushing there may mean never returning

text.content: Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's eyes blazed brilliantly: "What boldness! This Holy Maiden admires your魄力 of daring to strike at the heart directly." Demonic energy swirled around her, clearly ready for action: "The Eye of Heavenly Law's location, this Holy Maiden actually knows a thing or two about it—it's said to be deep within the forbidden grounds at the very center of the Nine Provinces continent, where ordinary cultivators don't even have the qualification to approach."

choices.description: First digest the information from the stone tablet, enhance your strength, and act when the timing is ripe. Haste makes waste—blind rushing will only lead to complete failure.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity, allowing the enemy to take the lead
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, strike a fatal blow at the critical moment
choices.risk_hint: The enemy will not give you much time to prepare

text.content: Su Qingyao nodded slightly, a hint of approval flickering in her eyes: "Indeed said. A being like the Eye of Heavenly Dao cannot be shaken overnight. Chen Ji, you are far steadier than you appear on the surface." Her tone carried newfound recognition, "The Tianqing Sect's archives may hold many texts that could help us understand Chen Xuan's layout more deeply."

Just as they were discussing, a subtle vibration emanated from the bottom of the stone tablet. Black cracks spread from the base, accompanied by a chilling aura as thick black mist gushed from the fissures, coalescing into a vague humanoid shadow within the stone chamber. The figure had no face, yet radiated an ancient, primeval pressure, as if an old god slumbering for eons was slowly awakening.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, instinctively shielding Su Qingyao and Ye Qing behind him. Even with prior anticipation, he couldn't help but bitterly苦笑—this ancestral trial truly unfolds one link after another, leaving no room to catch one's breath. He took a deep breath and asked gravely: "Who are you, honored guest? Why appear here?" The black shadow offered no answer, merely raising one hand to point distantly at the last line of text on the stone tablet not yet revealed.

text.content: As the black mist corroded, the bottom of the stone tablet revealed its true appearance once more. There was a line of chilling blood-red text carved there: "To obtain the seventh page of Heavenly Secrets, one must sacrifice the blood of the Prophet. One destined by heaven shall become the new vessel of the Eye of Heavenly Dao." Chen Ji's face instantly paled—so the so-called "reshaping of Heavenly Dao's rules" actually required the Prophet themselves as the sacrifice! His ancestor Chen Xuan—did he successfully break free from fate's shackles, or did he become a puppet of Heavenly Dao's will?

choice.prompt: The final line of text on the stone tablet was chilling—the Prophet would become the new vessel of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Facing this life-and-death choice, how should Chen Ji respond to this irreversible destiny?

choices.description: Since this is my bloodline, why should I fear? Chen Xuan walked that path—I, Chen Ji, can certainly forge a new road.
choices.visible_cost: May pay the price with one's life
choices.visible_reward: Gain the opportunity to break through fate's shackles
choices.risk_hint: The power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao far exceeds imagination

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao grabbed Chen Ji's wrist abruptly, her knuckles white from force: "Chen Ji, you're insane! Once the Heavenly Fate Value is depleted, you will be counterattacked by heaven unto death!" Her voice carried an unprecedented tremor, her eyes slightly reddened, "Who do you think you are? Why must you bear this alone?"

choices.text: Vow to break the shackles of destiny
choices.description: The path Chen Xuan walked is not the only way—the Tianji Record can foresee the future, so there must be a way to change fate.
choices.visible_cost: Need to pay an even greater price to seek variables
choices.visible_reward: May discover the secrets Chen Xuan left unfinished
choices.risk_hint: Variables often come with greater risks

text.content: Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji, a strange gleam flickering in her eyes: "You're more spirited than this Saintess imagined." She whispered softly, "The Holy Sect has a secret technique that can temporarily shield Heavenly Fate fluctuations... perhaps it could buy you some time." Her tone became unusually serious, "Of course, this is not free."

choices.text: Question the authenticity of the stone tablet
choices.description: Could this stone tablet be a trap deliberately left by Chen Xuan? Or has someone tampered with its contents? The truth may not be so simple.
choices.visible_reward: See through the conspiracy behind the surface
choices.risk_hint: Excessive suspicion may cause you to miss golden opportunities

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently. After a long silence, he slowly spoke: 'Master indeed left these words... But this old man always thought it was merely a psychological tactic.' His voice drifted and wavered, 'Master Chen Xuan never truly completed the collection of the seventh page. His last words before disappearing were—'I haven't lost yet.'

text.content: The black energy in the stone chamber grew increasingly dense. The blurred phantom seemed to gain consciousness, slowly drifting toward Chen Ji. It did not attack, but released an intangible force that firmly locked the four of them in place. At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace flew out on its own, emitting a faint golden light that formed a confrontation with the black energy. One page, two pages, three pages, four pages—four beams of light intertwined, outlining an ancient and mysterious pattern.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt a torrent of information surge into his mind—the Tianji Record was automatically recording something. Bearing through the dizziness, he carefully discerned the突如其来的 memory—it was a divine consciousness imprint left by Chen Xuan. In the vision, the ancestor stood atop a magnificent altar, surrounded by seven beams of light, while countless powerhouses knelt in worship below. 'Heaven's mandate is nothing but a puppet of the Heavenly Dao,' the Chen Xuan in the vision laughed heartily. 'In this life of mine, I, Chen Xuan, have only one purpose—to ensure that throughout all realms of heaven and earth, there shall be no predestination!'

text.content: The vision shifted abruptly. Chen Xuan's figure appeared within a vast star sea. Before him, an eye radiating boundless majesty gazed at him—the Eye of Heavenly Dao. After a moment of confrontation, Chen Xuan suddenly smiled: 'Do you think you've won?' He raised his hand, and seven beams of light gathered in his palm. 'No, this is merely the beginning. The moment the seventh page of the Tianji Record appears, you will understand—that the so-called destiny is merely history written by the strong.' The words fell, and Chen Xuan's figure dissolved as if he had never existed.

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's divine consciousness imprint revealed a shocking truth—he was not devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but chose to continue his struggle in another form. Now, Chen Ji must decide how to inherit this legacy.

choices.description: Though Chen Xuan was defeated, his spirit deserves to be inherited and promoted. Gather all seven pages of the Tianji Record and complete the ancestor's unfinished cause.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain all of Chen Xuan's inherited memories
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao has locked onto you

text.content: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged glances, both seeing shock and admiration in each other's eyes. Su Qingyao softly said: 'Chen Ji, whatever decision you make, I will be by your side.' Ye Qing snorted coldly: 'This saint respects people with backbone the most. Chen Xuan was one, and you... barely qualify as another.'

choices.description: Chen Xuan's methods may not suit me. Innovate and improve upon the ancestor's foundation, carving out a unique road of defying heaven that belongs to myself.
choices.visible_cost: Need to create a brand new cultivation technique, with extremely high risks
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a unique understanding of the Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: The path of innovation is filled with the unknown

text.content: Hearing this, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul image trembled violently: 'You... you wish to surpass your master?' His voice carried a hint of disbelief, yet also a trace of anticipation, 'If you can truly forge a new path, this old one... is willing to exhaust all remnant soul power to assist!'

The text on the stone tablet gradually dimmed, as if completing its mission. At the same time, the black shadow also slowly dissipated, leaving only a wisp of intangible presence lingering in the stone chamber. Chen Ji carefully stored the four pages of Tianji Record fragments in his embrace. His gaze fell upon the startling line of text at the base of the stone tablet, his mind racing with countless thoughts. 'Ancestor, what exactly did you want to tell me?' he murmured softly, 'As for so-called destiny, is it a shackle, or another form of guidance?'

Su Qingyao slowly walked to Chen Ji's side. She did not speak, simply standing quietly beside him. Ye Qing stood at the stone chamber entrance, demonic energy flickering around her body as she guarded for the two. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul floated above the stone tablet, his gaze deep and profound as he stared at the faded text. After a long while, he slowly spoke: 'Chen Ji, your master... was never truly gone. Perhaps, he has been waiting for someone who could surpass him.' The words fell, and a slight tremor suddenly came from the depths of the stone chamber, as if something was awakening.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji猛然抬头，目光穿透层层石壁，望向遗迹最深处那个从未有人涉足的区域。那里，有什么东西正在呼唤他——一种源自血脉深处的共鸣，如同久别重逢的呼唤，又似命运齿轮转动的轰鸣。他深吸一口气，嘴角微微上扬，那抹熟悉的狡黠笑容重新浮现：「看来先祖给我留下的，不止是一座石碑这么简单。」他转身看向两位红颜知己，眼中闪烁着熠熠光芒，「苏师姐，夜圣女——真正的冒险，现在才刚刚开始。」

text.content: Just as the four were preparing to explore deeper, a wisp of black energy suddenly seeped from the cracks at the base of the stone tablet. That aura was cold and biting, carrying an ancient and dangerous fluctuation—as if something was awakening. The black energy quickly condensed before the stone tablet, forming a line of twisted text: 'Congratulations, Chen family descendant, you have passed the first trial. But the real test... has just begun.' The text flickered a few times before dissipating without a trace, leaving only a chilling echo reverberating endlessly through the stone chamber.
